Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CRM.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1391 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 59 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2022.
We delivered record revenue of $47.5 billion this quarter, representing 18% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $47.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 59 basis points to 52.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
